title: Simulation 3D Terrain Sensor
text: Implement multipoint terrain sensor in 3D environment, 1 output; {Sensor identifier, sensorId} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Parent name, VehTag} sets the name of parent to which sensor is mounted, {Ray origins, RayOrigins} sets the ray origin, {Ray directions, RayDirections} sets the normalized ray direction, {Ray lengths, RayLengths}, {Number of wheels on parent vehicle}, {Visualize trace line} sets the visualize ray traces and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Parent name, VehTag
params.values: Name of parent to which sensor is mounted SimulinkVehicle1 (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Ray directions, RayDirections
params.values: Normalized ray direction [0 0 -1] (default) | real-valued N -by-3 array

params.name: Number of wheels on parent vehicle
